title: ITSP.10.171 authorized execution and deny-by-default settings need operating evidence
remediation: The sponsor endpoint control owner maintains and periodically reviews the approved software list. Review effective deny-all and allow-by-exception policy for the assessed execution paths. Retain redacted allowed and denied decisions using harmless approved examples. The sponsor confirms the assessed ITSP.10.171 supplementary boundary and accountable owner.

milestones.title: Collect the current approved software list, its dated review, effective execution policy and scoped allow and refusal results
